ATL.name: Keshon Gilbert
ATL.comment: Gilbert (knee) is out for Saturday's game against Brooklyn.

ATL.name: Asa Newell
ATL.comment: Newell (toe)  is out for Saturday's game against the Nets.

ATL.name: Jock Landale
ATL.comment: Landale (hip) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Nets.

ATL.name: Mouhamed Gueye
ATL.comment: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

ATL.name: Henri Veesaar
ATL.comment: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

BKN.name: Mikel Brown Jr.
BKN.comment: Brown, who finished with 18 points (5-13 FG, 3-8 3Pt, 5-7 FT), one rebound, three assists and one steal over 25 minutes in Saturday's 124-121 loss to Atlanta, won't play in Sunday's game against Dallas, Erik Slater of ClutchPoints.com reports.

BKN.name: Egor Demin
BKN.comment: The Nets exercised Demin's third-year team option for the 2027-28 season, Sharif Phillips-Keaton of USA Today reports Thursday.

CHA.name: Moussa Diabate
CHA.comment: Diabate (quadriceps) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Boston, according to the Hornets' official injury report.

CHA.name: Brandon Miller
CHA.comment: Head coach Charles Lee said Miller (groin) will be re-evaluated over the weekend, and they expect to have more information by Monday, Steve Reed of The Associated Press reports.

CHA.name: Dennis Schroder
CHA.comment: Schroder (thigh) is out for Friday's game versus Boston.

CHA.name: Kon Knueppel
CHA.comment: Knueppel (hamstring) is out for Friday's game against the Celtics.

CHA.name: Grant Williams
CHA.comment: The Hornets recalled Williams (hamstring) from the G League's Greensboro Swarm on Wednesday.

CHI.name: Tobe Awaka
CHI.comment: Awaka (knee) is questionable for Sundays' game against the 76ers.

CHI.name: Jalen Smith
CHI.comment: Smith (finger) is probable for Sunday's game against Philadelphia.

CHI.name: Nic Claxton
CHI.comment: Claxton (hamstring) has been downgraded to questionable for Sunday's game against the 76ers.

CHI.name: Zach Collins
CHI.comment: Collins (illness) is out for Sunday's game against Philadelphia.

CLE.name: Jaylon Tyson
CLE.comment: Tyson (ankle) is out for Saturday's game against the Knicks.

CLE.name: Sam Merrill
CLE.comment: Merrill (elbow) is out for Saturday's game against the Knicks.

CLE.name: Jarrett Allen
CLE.comment: Allen (knee) is out for Saturday's game against the Knicks

DAL.name: Sergio de Larrea
DAL.comment: De Larrea (knee) is out for Friday's game against Utah.

DAL.name: Tarik Biberovic
DAL.comment: Biberovic (heel) is listed as out for Monday's game against Sacramento.

DAL.name: Dereck Lively II
DAL.comment: Lively (foot) is listed as out for Monday's game against the Kings.

DEN.name: Julian Strawther
DEN.comment: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

DET.name: Isaiah Joe
DET.comment: Joe (hip) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Lakers.

DET.name: Isaac Jones
DET.comment: Jones posted 18 points (6-14 FG, 0-3 3Pt, 3-3 FT), 10 rebounds, an assist, two steals and two blocks in Wednesday's 100-88 Summer League loss to the Suns.

DET.name: Elijah Harkless
DET.comment: Harkless signed a two-way contract with the Pistons, Keith Smith of Spotrac.com reports.

DET.name: Jalen Duren
DET.comment: Duren will be re-evaluated in two weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.

GS.name: Kristaps Porzingis
GS.comment: Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.

GS.name: Moses Moody
GS.comment: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

GS.name: Jimmy Butler III
GS.comment: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

HOU.name: Clint Capela
HOU.comment: Capela (ankle) is out for Saturday's game against the Suns.

HOU.name: Steven Adams
HOU.comment: Head coach Ime Udoka said Wednesday that Adams (calf) is still without a timetable to return and will be evaluated on a "weekly basis," Varun Shankar of the Houston Chronicle reports.

IND.name: Tyrese Haliburton
IND.comment: Haliburton (hamstring) is progressing well but does not have a timetable to return, Dustin Dopirak of The Indianapolis Star reports.

IND.name: Johnny Furphy
IND.comment: Furphy (knee) is practicing with the G League's Noblesville Boom, per Alex Golden of SI.com.

IND.name: Ben Sheppard
IND.comment: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

LAC.name: Brandon Ingram
LAC.comment: Ingram (Achilles) won't play in Sunday's game against New Orleans, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.

LAC.name: Isaiah Jackson
LAC.comment: Jackson (groin) won't suit up for Sunday's game against the Pelicans, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.

LAC.name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
LAC.comment: The Clippers recalled Niederhauser (foot) from the G League's San Diego Clippers on Sunday.

LAC.name: Bradley Beal
LAC.comment: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

LAC.name: Jordan Miller
LAC.comment: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

LAL.name: Luka Doncic
LAL.comment: Doncic (back) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Pistons.

MEM.name: Richie Saunders
MEM.comment: Saunders signed a two-way contract with the Grizzlies on Saturday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

MEM.name: Isaiah Stewart
MEM.comment: Stewart (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Thunder.

MEM.name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
MEM.comment: Pippen (back) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Oklahoma City.

MIN.name: Joan Beringer
MIN.comment: Beringer (nose) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Jazz.

MIN.name: Anthony Edwards
MIN.comment: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

MIN.name: Donte DiVincenzo
MIN.comment: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

NO.name: Yves Missi
NO.comment: Missi (knee) is out for Friday's game against Minnesota.

NY.name: Josh Hart
NY.comment: Hart is out for Saturday's game against the Cavaliers due to right ankle soreness.

OKC.name: Jaylin Williams
OKC.comment: Williams (back) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Wizards, Brandon Rahbar of DailyThunder.com reports.

OKC.name: Thomas Sorber
OKC.comment: Sorber (knee) is out for Wednesday's game against the Cavaliers.

OKC.name: Cason Wallace
OKC.comment: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

OKC.name: Chet Holmgren
OKC.comment: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

OKC.name: Jalen Williams
OKC.comment: Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Tim MacMahon of ESPN.com reports.

ORL.name: Desmond Bane
ORL.comment: Bane (illness) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Warriors.

ORL.name: Jonathan Isaac
ORL.comment: Orlando recalled Isaac (knee) from the G League's Osceola Magic on Wednesday.

ORL.name: Jalen Suggs
ORL.comment: Suggs has been diagnosed with a mild bone bruise in his right knee and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

ORL.name: Paolo Banchero
ORL.comment: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

ORL.name: Noah Penda
ORL.comment: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

ORL.name: Izaiyah Nelson
ORL.comment: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

PHI.name: Joel Embiid
PHI.comment: Embiid (foot) is probable for Sunday's game against the Bulls.

PHI.name: Adem Bona
PHI.comment: Bona (back) is out for Sunday's game in Chicago.

PHI.name: Dominick Barlow
PHI.comment: Head coach Nick Nurse said Wednesday that Barlow (back) likely needs another 10-12 days before he's cleared to return to the court, Derek Bodner of AllPHLY.com reports.

PHI.name: Ariel Hukporti
PHI.comment: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

PHX.name: Jordan Goodwin
PHX.comment: Goodwin (calf) is out for Saturday's game against the Rockets.

PHX.name: Mark Williams
PHX.comment: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

POR.name: Ja Morant
POR.comment: Head coach Micah Nori said Morant met with a doctor in Los Angeles, who gave him a positive outlook on his recovery from the hamstring injury. While Nori declined to update Morant's timetable, he added Morant "may not be out for as long as we thought," Trail Blazers Insider Sean Highkin reports.

POR.name: Robert Williams III
POR.comment: Williams (rest) won't play in Saturday's game against the Spurs.

POR.name: Vit Krejci
POR.comment: Head coach Micah Nori said that Krejci suffered a left leg fracture during Wednesday's 132-119 win over the Suns, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

POR.name: Shaedon Sharpe
POR.comment: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

SAC.name: Keegan Murray
SAC.comment: Murray (ankle) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Heat.

SAC.name: Maxime Raynaud
SAC.comment: Raynaud (knee) is progressing in his rehabilitation and will be re-evaluated in approximately two weeks, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

SAC.name: Ben Simmons
SAC.comment: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

SA.name: Tobias Harris
SA.comment: Harris (calf) is listed as out for Saturday's game against Minnesota.

SA.name: Jayden Quaintance
SA.comment: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

TOR.name: Scottie Barnes
TOR.comment: Barnes (adductor) is listed as out for Friday's game against Milwaukee, Michael Grange of Sportsnet.ca reports.

TOR.name: Immanuel Quickley
TOR.comment: Quickley (hamstring) won't play Friday in Milwaukee, Michael Grange of Sportsnet.ca reports.

TOR.name: Kawhi Leonard
TOR.comment: Leonard has completed treatment to reduce swelling in his left knee and he will be re-evaluated in one week, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

TOR.name: Nate Bittle
TOR.comment: Bittle (foot) is out for Monday's game against the Clippers and remains without a timetable to return.

UTAH.name: Lauri Markkanen
UTAH.comment: Markkanen is questionable for Sunday's game against the Timberwolves due to a right wrist sprain.

UTAH.name: Jusuf Nurkic
UTAH.comment: Nurkic (toe) has begun participating in on-court activities as he continues recovering from a right foot injury sustained during an Oct. 4 preseason game against Denver. He will be re-evaluated in two weeks, the Jazz announced Friday.

UTAH.name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
UTAH.comment: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

WSH.name: Deandre Ayton
WSH.comment: Ayton won't return to Saturday's game against the Thunder due to a lower leg injury.

WSH.name: Anthony Davis
WSH.comment: Davis (ankle) won't play Saturday against the Thunder.

WSH.name: Reece Beekman
WSH.comment: The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.

WSH.name: Tristan Vukcevic
WSH.comment: Vukcevic (hip) is listed as out for Monday's game against Orlando.

WSH.name: Justin Champagnie
WSH.comment: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.

WSH.name: Jamir Watkins
WSH.comment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
